name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Financial support of ₹6,000 per year provided to all eligible landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: ₹6,000 annually paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts via DBT.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land in their names.
applicationProcess: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearby Common Service Centers (CSC).

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to minority/reserved categories studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage.
benefits: Complete maintenance allowance, non-refundable fee reimbursement, and book bank support.
eligibility: Students pursuing higher education post 10th grade whose annual family income is below ₹2.5 Lakh.
requiredDocuments: Mark sheets of previous qualifying examinations
Fee receipt of current academic session
applicationProcess: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State Scholarship Portal.
source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
